question: In Triple Jump, white flag indicates:
solution:
The correct answer is __**trail is valid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Triple jump:

__
 
• Landing Area: 9 meters in length and 2.75 meters in width.
 
• Take-off Board: 13 meters behind the pit (Men) and 11 Meters behind for (Women) and is white in color, 1.22 Meter length, and 20 cm in width.
 
• Plasticine Indicator Board: Indicate foul in the long jump. The length is 1.22 Meters and the Width is 10 cm
 
• Runway of Triple Jump: 40-45 meter
 
• Triple jump Phases are Approach run, Take off, Hop, Step, Jump, and Landing.
 
• In Triple Jump, white flag indicates: **trail is valid**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Jumping event: 

 
• These are basically events in which the main focus is a jump.
 
• These come under field events.
 
• Names of jumping events are:

 
• Long Jump,
 
• High jump,
 
• Triple Jump,
 
• Pole vault.
